related.description: This Raspberry Pi distribution for managing Klipper 3D printers with Mainsail provides all you need.
Web-App Dashboard to monitor Raspberry Pi hardware and software status. Nothing more than Webserver + PHP required.
Monitor your Raspberry Pi without needing to constantly SSH into it by using your own client to fetch hardware/service info about your Pi.
Robust, Ubiquitous and Massively Scalable Messaging Platform (XMPP, MQTT, SIP Server)
